stemMd: An amount is split so that one person receives 40% and another receives 90 euros more than the first. What is the total?
explanationMd: The second share is 60%; the difference is 20% of the total. Thus total=90/0.20=450.

distractorRationale.a: Treats 90 as the whole second share.
